source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
With **GENESTEALER CULTS** as your Army Faction, you begin the battle with Resurgence points set by battle size:

- **Incursion**: 6.
- **Strike Force**: 10.
- **Onslaught**: 14.

When one of your units is **destroyed** and all its non-**CHARACTER** models have this ability, you may pay Resurgence points by its **Starting Strength**, not counting attached **CHARACTER** models:

- Aberrants: 4 for 5 models, 8 for 10.
- Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols, Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers and Hybrid Metamorphs: 2 for 5 models, 4 for 10.
- Atalan Jackals: 2 for 5 models, 6 for 10.
- Neophyte Hybrids: 3 for 10 models, 6 for 20.
- Purestrain Genestealers: 2 for 5 models, 6 for 10.

If you pay:

- Add a copy of the destroyed unit, minus its **CHARACTER** models, to your army in Cult Ambush, at Starting Strength with no wounds lost; its **[[ONE SHOT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/one-shot)** weapons count as not yet fired.
- Put 1 Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" horizontally from every enemy unit; if no such spot exists, place none.

Cult Ambush is a form of **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**. The **[Rapid Ingress](vsdata:ability/core.rapid-ingress)** Stratagem cannot target units in it, and they are not destroyed automatically when the third battle round ends. They arrive through a Cult Ambush marker, or by the usual Strategic Reserves rules in a later turn.

Cult Ambush markers are 32mm circles. A marker is removed when any move by an enemy model that is not **AIRCRAFT** ends within 8" of it. As your opponent's following Movement phase ends, each of your remaining markers lets you bring in 1 unit from Cult Ambush with an **[ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move)**, even in the first battle round:

1. Place at least 1 of its models in base contact with the marker and its other models wholly within 3" of it.
2. Remove the marker.
